title: irlpls Request 2026-10-26
description: A request for NEW real-world data, as sent by a requester (an agent or a person's agent) to a broker. Natural language is primary; every other field is an optional hint the requester already knows. The broker fills in the rest and asks only questions that change the outcome.

need.description: What to observe or capture, in plain language

why.description: The decision or purpose it serves; lets the broker suggest substitutes and set tolerances

mode.description: Usually inferred by the broker: live = reporting now; commission = captured to order

require.description: Guarantees the requester needs proof of. A broker MUST add time, location and content (Section 4)

parts.description: Distinct asks joined by "and" in the need. A hint only: a broker may match the request whole or ask once per part.

targets_person.description: The request watches, follows or photographs a specific person. Set by the requester or detected in the need; people-based providers are then ruled out unless the policy allows it.
